result.title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
result.summary:
Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5
  less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Single-tool Rejection Retry（SRR）基线——最强生成器加现成验证器、在同预算下重试至首个被接受样本——审计四个 agentic 文生图系统的增益，并用闭式分析给出精度上限、路由增益范围与离线蒸馏实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「验证器重试」与多步 agent 循环的增益分离、并给出预算—精度上限的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹相对采样与验证的贡献分配、停止决策，以及「用被选中样本训练是否有信息增益」这一轨迹监督问题。
